name: senpi-strategy-discover
description: Find the Senpi template that best fits the user's idea, as the BASE of their own strategy: they fork it and make it theirs (a lever shifted, a rule of their own) before it goes live. Called by senpi-strategy-author to find a base for a thesis, and directly when the user asks to browse ("show me your templates", "a ready-made fund") or names a template. Strategy asks ("what should I trade?", "recommend a strategy", "trade for me") start in senpi-strategy-author. Every pick deploys as `<User>'s <Template>` (or a name of their own) after ops walks them through it. You talk and RANK (their worldview as `--theme`); a hidden engine (scripts/discover.py) fetches data + filters. NOT for installing a NAMED strategy (senpi-strategy-ops) or building one (senpi-strategy-author).
